models_evaluated: 35 open-weight LLMs (including Qwen2.5 and biomedical models)

links.outcome: Model calibration and confident errors on plausible distractors in surgical multiple-choice questions
links.effect: Best model reached 68.1% accuracy; smaller models often near 25% random baseline; even strong models made confident mistakes on clinically plausible distractors.
links.quote: Calibration and error analysis further show that even strong models make confident mistakes on clinically plausible distractors, motivating more reliable and broader surgical LLM evaluation.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific surgical benchmark construction using a source-grounded multi-stage generation, verification, and expert-audit pipeline

screen.reason: The paper presents SurgiQ, a large-scale surgical domain benchmark evaluating 35 LLMs on multiple-choice questions, assessing their surgical reasoning and knowledge without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
